card.name: The 0 ending cytochrome P450
card.fires_on: The final digit 0 in "P450" when it follows "cytochrome P45" in drug-interaction text. It fires at the end of the enzyme name, just before isoenzyme or CYP numbers such as 3A4 or 1A2.

modes.label: Heading or list use
modes.description: The 0 of P450 in section titles or warning lists about cytochrome P450 isoenzymes.

modes.label: Running text use
modes.description: The 0 of P450 in sentences on how a drug is metabolized by the enzyme system.
modes.example: Amprenavir, the active metabolite of fosamprenavir, is metabolized in the liver by the cytochrome P45<<0>> enzyme system.
